summary: Tested AI Products feature flag functionality. Found and fixed a bug where AdminProductEditor.jsx was using the admin endpoint (/api/admin-settings/feature-flags) which requires auth, causing it to default to true when auth fails. Fixed to use public endpoint (/api/settings/feature-flags). Backend correctly returns ai_products in public feature flags and AI endpoint returns 403 when disabled.

ui_bugs.issue: Was using admin endpoint for feature flags which requires auth, defaulting to true on auth failure

critical_code_review_comments: Backend /api/settings/feature-flags correctly returns ai_products key with boolean value
Backend /api/ai/product-lookup correctly checks is_ai_products_enabled() and returns 403 when disabled
Frontend AdminProductEditor.jsx now uses public endpoint /api/settings/feature-flags (no auth required)
Frontend correctly hides AIProductLookup component when aiProductsEnabled is false
No regression in other feature flags - all expected keys present (coming_soon, left_menu, printful/yoycol, owner_chat)

bug_fix_details.root_cause: AdminProductEditor.jsx was calling /api/admin-settings/feature-flags which requires admin auth. When the request failed (401), the catch block defaulted aiProductsEnabled to true, causing the AI Product Generator to always show.
bug_fix_details.fix_applied: Changed endpoint from /api/admin-settings/feature-flags to /api/settings/feature-flags (public endpoint that doesn't require auth)
